resources.string: This deletes the listed original media and related metadata, not just a preview or proxy. This action cannot be undone. Review every file before confirming.
I understand that these original files and metadata will be permanently deleted.
Deletion is in progress. Cancellation is no longer available; wait for the per-file result. Leaving this screen does not stop an operation already confirmed.
Deletion was partial. Review every file result; do not assume the take was fully deleted.
Deletion was rejected. Review the current catalog before making a new selection.
Deletion outcome is unknown. Refresh the catalog and inspect the remaining files before taking further action.
A catalog refresh was requested. A loading or read error is not proof that a file is absent.
